# SOP-P1-L4-05 Planned shutdown - Heat Treat line
Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, EQ-P1-L4-HT03

Purpose
1. Define controlled sequence and responsibilities for a planned shutdown of the Heat Treat line to support maintenance, inspection, or changeover activities while protecting personnel, equipment, and process integrity.

Scope
2. Applies to all technicians, maintenance personnel, and supervision involved with EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, and EQ-P1-L4-HT03 on P1-L4 during planned shutdowns. Refer to ECN-2026-007 for engineering changes that may affect shutdown scope, and to MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 for machine-specific maintenance sequences.

Background and rationale
3. Planned shutdowns are required to perform inspections, preventive maintenance, and engineering modifications with minimal risk. A controlled shutdown sequence prevents inadvertent energization, avoids hydraulic and thermal stress on components, and ensures safety systems remain functional for the duration of the outage. Example: isolating hydraulic pressure at EQ-P1-L4-HP02 before removing fittings prevents uncontrolled movement; the system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 300 bar and must not be exceeded during re-pressurization steps specified in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2. For EQ-P1-L4-HT03, maintain quench control parameters to prevent soak and quench timing errors; the quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 15 seconds.

Preconditions (required before initiating shutdown)
4. Confirm authorized work order and scope per ECN-2026-007.  
5. Verify required personnel and tools are available and trained.  
6. Review machine-specific maintenance sequences MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 and confirm no outstanding hold points outside the shutdown scope.  
7. Inform downstream and upstream production leads that P1-L4 Heat Treat line will be taken out of service.  
8. Ensure spare parts and consumables referenced in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 are staged.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
9. Mandatory PPE for shutdown tasks: safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear, and arc-rated clothing where electrical exposure is possible. Additional PPE required by MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 or MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 must be used when performing those procedures.

Shutdown steps (numbered sequence)
10. Prepare for shutdown:  
   10.1. Post lockout/tagout notification at P1-L4 access points and at control station for EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, EQ-P1-L4-HT03.  
   10.2. Verify energy sources identified on single-line diagrams per ECN-2026-007.

11. Isolate utilities:  
   11.1. Close primary feed valves to EQ-P1-L4-HT03 and EQ-P1-L4-CN01 following procedures in MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3.  
   11.2. De-energize electrical control panels and apply lockout/tagout.  
   11.3. Drain hydraulic accumulators per MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and verify system pressure falls below a safe threshold before work on EQ-P1-L4-HP02. Remember: the system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 300 bar; do not exceed this limit during any pressurization step.

12. Verification and hold points:  
   12.1. Use pressure indicators and valve position confirmation to verify isolation.  
   12.2. Attempt controlled start on each isolated unit after lockout; equipment must not energize. Record verification results.

13. Safe access and work:  
   13.1. Install physical barriers and signage.  
   13.2. Permit only authorized persons within the work area.  
   13.3. Follow task-specific PPE and procedures in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 for component removal or inspection.

14. Special control - quench system:  
   14.1. When performing maintenance on EQ-P1-L4-HT03 quench circuits, set control parameters to safe mode per MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3. The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 15 seconds; confirm quench delay setting at the controller before returning the unit to service.

15. Reassembly and pre-start checks:  
   15.1. Reinstall guards, panels, and fittings per machine-specific procedures.  
   15.2. Remove lockout/tagout only after inspection and authorization. Conduct pre-start checklist and review items in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3.

16. Controlled startup:  
   16.1. Gradually reintroduce utilities and controls. Monitor pressure and control feedback closely. Ensure system pressure for EQ-P1-L4-HP02 remains within acceptable limit during re-pressurization; the system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 300 bar.  
   16.2. Validate quench timing on EQ-P1-L4-HT03; verify quench delay setting is not greater than 15 seconds.

Records to keep
17. Maintain the following records in the document control folder associated with SOP-P1-L4-05 and linked work order: shutdown authorization, lockout/tagout logs, isolation verification records, pre-start and post-start checklists, parts replaced with reference to MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 or MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 where applicable, pressure and quench configuration snapshots, and final sign-off. Include a reference to ECN-2026-007 for any deviations resulting from engineering changes.

Examples and typical issues
18. Example: During re-pressurization of EQ-P1-L4-HP02, monitor pressure gauge behavior against MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 guidance. If pressure overshoot is observed relative to the system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 300 bar, stop and investigate.  
19. Example: If quench control on EQ-P1-L4-HT03 logs an unexpected delay above the quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 15 seconds, enter a hold and troubleshoot using MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3.

Responsibilities
20. Maintenance supervisor: authorize shutdown, ensure procedures and spare parts are available, and verify final sign-off.  
21. Lead technician: execute steps, maintain records, and notify supervisor of anomalies.  
22. Operators: secure production interfaces and support isolation verification.

Sign-off
23. Complete the sign-off sheet with: work order number, names and signatures of maintenance supervisor, lead technician, and operations representative, confirmation that ECN-2026-007, MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2, and MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 were consulted and complied with, and that records listed in section 17 are filed.

Related documents
24. ECN-2026-007  
25. MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2  
26. MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3
